articles.title: After homer in 10th stings them, Cardinals' comeback falls shorts in loss to Giants
articles.description: The Cardinals dropped their series finale vs. the Giants after closer Riley O'Brien allowed a two-run homer on the first pitch he threw in the 10th inning on Wednesday.

articles.title: In rough start vs. Giants, Cardinals' Andre Pallante sees cost of two-strike execution
articles.description: During his Tuesday start vs. the Giants, Cardinals starter Andre Pallante allowed a career-high eight runs. He saw how a lack of execution in two-strike counts can prove costly.

articles.title: Hochman: 40* home runs! Cardinals prospect Jesus Baez makes execs dream, fans drool
articles.description: From Springfield, Cardinals Class AA prospect Jesus Baez discussed his mentor and mentality toward making the majors.

articles.title: While Springfield's loss sets up Game 3, Memphis nears elimination after Game 1 defeat
articles.description: Class AA Springfield and Class AAA Memphis dropped playoffs games on Tuesday night. The defeats set up both Cardinals affiliates to play elimination games on Wednesday.

articles.title: 'A lot to be excited about': What Oli Marmol, players said after Cardinals beat White Sox
articles.description: The young Cardinals performed well Friday night as the 2006 World Series title team looked on. Here's what Oliver Marmol, Leo Bernal, Joshua Baez and Matthew Liberatore had to say.

articles.title: Cardinals produced ‘when it mattered,' but contact ends in outs in latest 1-run game
articles.description: After benefiting from the Giants' mistakes, the Cardinals' hard contact helped them send Wednesday's game to the 10th inning but it couldn't help them avoid a 6-5 loss.

articles.title: During 'tough' day for lineup, Alec Burleson’s strides vs. lefties drives Cardinals offense
articles.description: The Cardinals received all three of their runs in a win on a two-out double Alec Burleson produced against the lefty the White Sox called in to neutralize him.

articles.title: 'Not the season I wanted': What Oli Marmol, players said after Cardinals' loss to Giants
articles.description: Here's what Oliver Marmol as well as Matthew Liberatore, Jordan Walker, Leo Bernal and JJ Wetherholt had to say after a 10-inning Cardinals loss to the Giants.

articles.title: 'I want to be perfect': What Alec Burleson, Cardinals said after taking White Sox series
articles.description: Here's what Oli Marmol, Alec Burleson and Michael McGreevy had to say after a 3-1 series-clinching win for the Cardinals on Sunday over the White Sox.

articles.title: After breaking up bid at perfection, Cardinals hang on for 3-1 win over White Sox
articles.description: The Cardinals received three runs in a sixth-inning double from Alec Burleson and got a successful save from George Soriano to complete a 3-1 win over the White Sox.

articles.title: How much has bullpen hamstrung Cardinals? What the stats say as Giants visit: First Pitch
articles.description: A look at where this woeful Cardinals bullpen stacks up historically as St. Louis opens a three-game series with the Giants, on Monday night at 6:45 p.m.
